Description: Significant Wave Height (SWH) of Wind Waves: Average height of the highest one-third of wind-generated waves
Significant Wave Height (SWH) of Primary Swell Waves: Average height of the highest one-third of primary swell waves
Mean Wave Direction of Wind Waves: Prevailing direction from which wind waves are coming
Mean Wave Direction of Primary Swell Waves: Prevailing direction from which primary swell waves are coming
Mean Wave Period of Wind Waves: Characteristic time interval between successive crests of wind waves
Mean Wave Period of Primary Swell Waves: Characteristic time interval between successive crests of primary swell waves
